services.desc: Kuenzel Mills in New Bremen, Ohio. This is print from a series of oil paintings of New Bremen Scenes by artist Pat Wietholter. [from “The Towpath” - May 1983-January 1984 issues][Excerpts taken from Historic Tour at 1976 Bremenfest, as prepared by Mary Ann Brown.] Ten acres of land were purchased from the government at one dollar an acre. It was surveyed by R. Grant of Mercer County and divided into 102 lots, each 66 by 300 feet. One lot was reserved for each member of the company that had been organized at Cincinnati.
